answer: Every identity is a vertex in the graph, and the network hides canary oases among real services: decoy jobs that look like easy prey yet pay nothing real. A raven sentinel watches each oasis, and any vertex biting the bait loses its bond and is quarantined. Honest agents never touch an oasis, since legitimate work is routed elsewhere, so honesty costs nothing. A farm cannot tell decoy from real service, so running 1,000 fakes means sacrificing identities to probe every oasis: each fake costs one burned bond plus the audit trail exposing its siblings.
